name: Soh Hanamiya
source:
[i]"You've got nothing to worry about."[/i]
[i]"With all due respect. Taking care of a woman is troublesome. But I don't have much choice. As long as you do what I said. And promise not to do anything crazy or silly. You'll be alright. Got it?"[/i]

A leader of the A Team. Smart and cool-headed.

Soh is difficult to understand; a bit cold and mean to you. He has a sharp tongue, but sometimes shows you his gentle side. He is a descendant of a samurai family, who has a sword skill besides calligraphy. Using his telepathy, Soh could be reading your mind!
